content.text: Wikification is key.

To fully address this, the tutorials need to be turned into web-browsable documents so they're easier to read and edit.  For now, we're pointing to this issue from the wiki page on which the PDFs are listed, so people can find the attachment.
Not enough time to address this for 3.2; pushed to a future release.
Also see
http://permalink.gmane.org/gmane.comp.cms.fedora-commons.user/5628
The tutorials need going through to check they still work (and if there are any underlying issues).
UPDATE:
The original description for this bug was of a very limited set of tutorial sample files left out of the distribution.

As of Fedora Version 3.4.2, all of the tutorial sample files referenced in tutorial2.pdf (dated July 23, 2008) are no longer included in the distribution.  Specifically the userdocs subdirectory.  For instance, in the PDF's page 11 the following 3 tutorial sample files are referenced (but are no longer included in the distribution):
It is now time to add the eprint document formats as new datastreams. You can find content for creating the datastreams for this example in:
FEDORA_HOME/userdocs/tutorials/2/example1/artex.html
FEDORA_HOME/userdocs/tutorials/2/example1/artex.pdf
FEDORA_HOME/userdocs/tutorials/2/example1/artex.tex
The download link for tutorial2.pdf (dated July 23, 2008) is here:
https://wiki.duraspace.org/download/attachments/4718930/tutorial2.pdf?version=1&modificationDate=1218446070039
For more history on this issue, a partial history can be found in the following thread on the "fedora-commons-users" list (aka [fcrepo-user] ):
http://sourceforge.net/mailarchive/forum.php?thread_name=4426846A-812B-438A-A359-B9B82006E7AF%40mbl.edu&forum_name=fedora-commons-users
Discussed at last week's committer meeting. Dan volunteered to "wikify" the existing tutorial docs to make them easier to update.  That way more people can contribute to their improvement.
legacy 3.x

With Fedora 3.1, the SDep.xml, SDef.xml, CModel.xml and other xml files were omitted from the distribution.  It looks like these were lost in the migration of the documentation to the wiki.  They need to be reviewed and included in the distribution, or along with the tutorial.
Stuart wrote:
> I decided to try and regenerate the example3 tutorial documents myself and update them for
> the 3.1 implementation of Fedora. I am not sure that they are perfect (i.e. completely schema
> compliant) but they load into Fedora 3.1 fine and work.  Please find a .zip file attached with
> the documents I came up with.
(see attachment)
